regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, author block, and SI statement
regions.finding: Article identity and aggregate AuCl/PtCl2 cyclization claims inspected. The page states that SI exists online, but source mapping leaves SI association unestablished; no SI facts were imported.

regions.region: page 1 introduction, Equations (1)–(4)
regions.finding: Four distinct cited metal-carbene formation classes were classified as prior-literature examples: alpha-oxo Au carbene from activated alkynes, intramolecular leaving-group route, 1,5-enyne cyclopropyl carbene route, and allene cyclization route. Generic intermediates are not current-paper experiments.

unresolved: Equations (1)–(4) contain generic R/LG/Nu/X groups and omit experiment-level conditions/yields.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left Equation (5)
regions.finding: The generic cyclic metal-carbene route summarizes cited work beginning in 2009 and is classified as mechanism, not a preparation of the drawn intermediate.

regions.region: page 2 lower-left Scheme 1 and surrounding comparison text
regions.finding: The PtCl2 cyclization is explicitly prior reference 14 (2012), with generic competing migration branches. It is retained as a literature example and not merged into current AuCl scope rows.

regions.region: page 2 right column computational methodology and start of Figure 1 discussion
regions.finding: The current DFT calculation uses 2a as model substrate with B3LYP/6-311G(d,p)/LANL2DZ and CPCM; it contributes to one cross-page mechanism record rather than a preparative experiment.

unresolved: Scheme 1 does not restate catalyst loading, solvent, time, or yields from reference 14.
The DFT record is not a complete computational-data extraction.

regions.region: page 3 Figure 1 energy profile and mechanism prose
regions.finding: The Pt/Au cyclization, water-assisted elimination, and 1,2-H-shift pathways are calculated mechanisms. Key 31.0, 2.4, 18.1, and 11.3 kcal/mol barriers were retained without treating Int1–Int4 as isolated compounds.

regions.region: page 3 Figure 2 optimized Int4 geometries
regions.finding: Bond lengths/Wiberg indices characterize the same DFT intermediates and do not create a separate reaction record.

regions.region: page 3 lower-right Experimental studies paragraph
regions.finding: Two distinct current experiments are introduced: 2b gives 3b in 87% after 30 min, and 2c gives 3c in 88% after 1 h. The latter is the same run shown in Scheme 2 and Table 3 entry 1 and is merged across pages.

unresolved: Scheme 2 operational workup, purification, masses, and yield basis are not yet reported on pages 1–6.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left Scheme 2
regions.finding: The displayed 2b and 2c AuCl/DCE reactions confirm the two current experiments introduced on page 3; 2c is cross-listed as Table 3 entry 1 and is not duplicated.

regions.region: page 4 upper-right Table 1 entries 1–9 and footnotes
regions.finding: Nine independent catalyst/concentration optimization conditions were retained with row catalyst, DCE/toluene, time, combined NMR yield, regioisomer ratio, solvent-volume overrides, 1 mol% AuCl override, and the entry-8 AgSbF6 additive. Entry 6's 23% table-footnote versus 24% narrative recovery conflict is preserved.

regions.region: page 4 lower-right Table 2 entries 1–8 and footnotes
regions.finding: Eight temperature/solvent rows were inspected. Table 2 entry 1 is identical to Table 1 entry 5 and is merged; entries 2–8 remain separate. The image resolves entry 5 as CH2Cl2/17 h/6%/92:8, and the toluene row retains 23% recovered 2d.

regions.region: page 4 narrative introducing Table 3
regions.finding: The prose maps current 4,4-dialkyl scope experiments to Table 3 on page 5; no duplicate narrative-only records were created.

unresolved: Table 1 entry 6 reports recovered 2d as 23% in the footnote and 24% in prose.
Optimization tables omit atmosphere, workup, purification, masses, and ratio method.

regions.region: page 5 upper-left Table 3 entries 1–7 and footnotes
regions.finding: Seven current AuCl scope experiments were retained with exact R-label strings, time, 0.2 mmol scale, catalyst/solvent overrides, N2, and isolated yields; entry 1 is merged with Scheme 2. Three numerical Ref. 14 Pt comparisons are separate literature-example records, while table dashes remain absence of a reported comparison rather than zero.

regions.region: page 5 lower-left Table 4 entries 1–4 and footnote
regions.finding: Four current AuCl 4-alkyl-4-aryl experiments were retained separately. The Ref. 14 column is represented by four prior-literature records, including the explicit no-reaction result for 2n under the prior Pt process.

regions.region: page 5 upper-right Table 5 entries 1–5
regions.finding: Five distinct current experiments were retained with combined isolated yields/ratios and separate post-recrystallization yields/ratios. Entry 4 is the independent 3 mmol (1.0770 g) repeat of 2p and is not merged with entry 3.

regions.region: page 5 Figure 3 ORTEP and adjacent text
regions.finding: The ORTEP supports the source assignment of 3p and is characterization of Table 5, not a second preparation or machine-structure verification.

unresolved: Current scope rows omit workups, purifications, masses, and selectivity analytical methods.
Reference-14 comparison conditions are only partially restated.
ORTEP does not certify candidate machine structures.

regions.region: page 6 left Table 6 entries 1–8 and footnotes
regions.finding: Eight independent AuCl scope rows were retained with row time/yield and footnote overrides for DCE volume and 10 mol% catalyst. The source says migration is exclusive but gives no numerical minor-isomer ratios.

regions.region: page 6 Figure 4 ORTEP
regions.finding: ORTEP characterization supports the assigned 3x structure but is not another preparation and does not verify a machine encoding.

regions.region: page 6 upper-right Equation (6)
regions.finding: A separate 2aa experiment gives cyclopropyl- and ethyl-migrated products 3aa/3aa' in 81% combined yield and 95:5 ratio after 2 h.

regions.region: page 6 center-right Scheme 3 graph and water-effect prose
regions.finding: Two molecular-sieve conditions were retained as separate conversion-profile experiments. Approximate graph points preserve the printed square/triangle legend. The graph labels the 'with 4 Å MS' curve as faster, while prose says adding sieves lowers the rate; this source conflict remains unresolved.

regions.region: page 6 lower-right theoretical-selectivity introduction
regions.finding: This prose introduces calculated migration barriers continued in Table 7 on page 7. No additional page-6 preparative experiment or complete Table 7 row is created.

unresolved: Scheme 3 graph/legend conflicts with its adjacent mechanistic prose about the molecular-sieve rate effect.
Graph points are approximate visual readings and the conversion analytical method is not stated.
Table 7 lies on page 7 and is outside this coverage claim.
